tests.wiki_level: Daily views (user agent, all-access, en.wikipedia, per-article API; several articles summed). e = stone date. Baseline b = median of days e-120 to e-15. m = mean of the window. r = m / max(b, 1). Placebo: pseudo-dates every 14th day of the page's own history (index 130, 144, ... up to e-200) with a complete baseline and window, the same offsets; p = (1 + #(r' >= r)) / (1 + N), N >= 20 or the prediction is void. Seasonal check: r must exceed r at e-365, e-730 and e-1095 wherever those exist. Material: m - b >= 20 views a day and r >= 1.5. Moved = p <= 0.05 and material and the seasonal check passed. Order: the checker's onset (editor_trail.onset from e-30, as in chain_check.wiki_test); order holds when there is no onset or the onset is no earlier than e-3.
tests.library_month: Monthly checkouts summed over all usage classes and material types for titles starting with any listed prefix whose creator contains the listed name (upper case). s(M) = ln(c(M) + 1) - ln(mean(c(M-1), c(M-2), c(M-3)) + 1). Placebo: s for every month from 2013-01 to two months before M, excluding Mar 2020 to Jun 2021 (closures); p = (1 + #(s' >= s)) / (1 + N). Seasonal check: s exceeds s for the same calendar month of every prior year in the pool. Material: c(M) - mean of the 3 months before >= 10. Moved = p <= 0.05 and material and seasonal. Order: the same test on M-1 (September 2026, pool ending at M-3); order holds when M-1 did not move. Pending until month M is published; void after the deadline.
tests.hansard_mention: UK Parliament Hansard API (search/contributions/Spoken.json) for the term between the window dates; the count of contributions whose sitting date is inside the window.
tests.uk_bill_first_reading: UK Parliament Bills API: every bill returned for any search term whose short title matches the regex; first reading = the earliest sitting date of its first stage; count bills whose first reading falls inside the window.

move.bust: moved but began more than 3 days before the stone (wiki) or in the month before (library): the ordering rule

not move.bust: moved, in order, p <= 0.01 and r >= 10 (wiki): a strong ripple where none was predicted
not move.void: moved but began before the stone: neither credited nor blamed

record move.hit: at least one record in the window

verdicts.void: an article missing or renamed, fewer than 20 placebo windows, a source that refused (403, 429 or 5xx) on every weekly try until the deadline, or data unpublished by the deadline. A void is never rescored with a different series.
